text: Popper character design. This is our design for the Popper character. The embodiment of our computational skepticism framework. Inspired by philosopher Carl Pauper, we've created a 1940s era intellectual with a penetrating gaze and determined expression that reflects his unwavering commitment to critical thinking. The Popper framework is our open-source platform for AI validation that applies a scientific skepticism to artificial intelligence. Just as Carl Pauper revolutionized science with his principle that theories gain strength by surviving attempts at falsification, our Popper character represents the systematic examination of evidence both for and against AI systems through specialized validation agents orchestrated by a central verification layer. The Popper framework helps developers discover what approaches to
AI validation actually work in practice. Like the character's vintage aesthetic suggests, we're bringing time-t tested philosophical principles into the cutting edge of AI validation.
